optimizedContext.value:
# Change Transition

## Rules

- Commands: `specd changes transition <name> <step> [--skip-hooks <phases>] [--allow-out-of-scope] [--format text|json|toon]`; alias `specd change transition ...`; or `--next`. `<name>` required; `<step>` required unless `--next`; mutually exclusive.
- `--next`: pass `to: 'next'` to `TransitionChange.execute`; Core resolves happy-path state. CLI MUST NOT keep routing table or use `GetStatus.nextAction` as resolver. Core rejection (including `pending-spec-approval`, `pending-signoff`, `archivable`, `archiving`): exit 1, stderr `error:` explaining no auto-advance.
- `--skip-hooks`: comma-separated `source.pre`, `source.post`, `target.pre`, `target.post`, `all`; map to `skipHookPhases`. Omit: all applicable hooks. `all`: caller runs `specd change run-hooks`.
- `--allow-out-of-scope`: set `allowOutOfScope: true`; affects only `impl.linksInScope`, never `impl.filesResolved`. Omit: do not set input. `--format` default `text`.
- Do not call `RefreshImplementationTracking` or `ImplementationDetector`. Pre-transition and repair `GetStatus`: `refreshImplementationTracking: false`; `TransitionChange` owns default refresh.
- No approval flags to `TransitionChange.execute`; kernel uses `config.approvals`. Do not rewrite logical target for approval/signoff; failures remain `ready`/`done`.
- Default hooks: source.post → target.pre → transition; fail-fast. Hook fail: exit 2, stderr `error:`, no Repair Guide.
- Pass `onProgress`: text generic check bus (`check-start`, optional `check-progress`, `check-done`); hooks same bus (`Running pre hooks`/`Running post hooks`), no `Executing:`. Render `<label> (<id>)`, optional lines, then `✓ <label>` or `✗ <label>: <reason>`.
- Transition hooks MUST stay observable in-flight, including later failures. Use generic check-progress presenter; `change run-hooks` MAY retain hook-progress presenter. Do not share public JSON stream name.
- `json`/`toon`: stdout NDJSON, all progress/events `stream: "change-transition"`; terminal `event.type: "complete"`, `event.result` success=`result`, `name`, `from`, `to`; failure=`result: "failure"`, `name`, `from`, `to`, `blockers`, `nextAction`.
- Text success: final confirmation stdout after stderr progress. Invalid/requires/incomplete-task failures: exit 1, stderr `error:`; incomplete tasks name blocking artifact.
- Text `InvalidStateTransitionError`/repair-guide errors: stderr Repair Guide from `GetStatus` transition-check `blockers`/`nextAction`; line `! <CODE> — <label>: <message>` or no-label `! <CODE>: <message>`. Surface approval/signoff reason.

## Constraints

- Help exposes logical target, never routing.
- Repair diagnostics projected from Core, never recomputed by CLI.
- Text: progress stderr, confirmation stdout. `json`/`toon`: stream stdout; stderr only non-structured diagnostics.
